The '''river otter''' was a type of [[otter]]. The [[Sessehshellah]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|race]] of [[mustalid]]s native to the<ref name="RoBW" /> [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''&mdash;Based on corresponding data for [[Shaymore system/Legends|Shaymore system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shaymore]], resembled larger versions of river otters.<ref name="RoBW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The river otter was first mentioned to describe the Sessehshellah in "[[Rings of Bright Water]]", an adventure written by [[Ken Rolston]] and collected in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|first edition]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' in [[October]] [[1987]].<ref name="RoBW" /> The out-of-universe article ''[[Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000]]'' also describes the [[Tynnan]]s as river otters;<ref name="WWD2000">''[[Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000]]''</ref> however, ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' classifies the Tynnans as [[sea otter]]s.<ref name="SWUGSec">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>
